content:
Maria L.: quick heads-up — need to swap primary for tonight. booking conflict; I can cover until 23:00 PST but then need to hand off earlier than planned.
AJ: ok, what window are we trying to cover exactly?
Maria L.: primary from 23:00 PST -> 07:00 PST. I can do 23:00-02:00 but can't do the overnight stretch after 02:00. asking if AJ or Lee can take 02:00-07:00.
Lee: i can take 02:00-05:00 but have a meeting at 05:30 that might bleed.
Samir: i can cover 05:00-07:00 if someone takes 02:00-05:00. small overlap but better than a gap.
Maria L.: sweet. so proposed: Maria 23:00-02:00, Lee 02:00-05:00, Samir 05:00-07:00. AJ you were originally scheduled as secondary — can you stay as secondary for the whole window so on-call escalation path is consistent?
AJ: yes I can remain secondary. fyi I have VPN issues earlier but should be resolved by 22:30.
oncall-bot: Incident summary — no active P1s. Recent alert spike at 20:18 resolved automatically. See /alerts for details.
alerts-bot: Recent rate-limited spikes: 20:18-20:22 — no customer impact detected, dropped once.
Maria L.: good. couple of housekeeping items before the handoff:
- confirm runbook link and escalation matrix
- ensure bridge numbers and pager rotation updated
- mention any ongoing noisy alerts or customer tickets

Lee: runbook link is https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff — includes checklist and comm templates.
Samir: escalation matrix here: https://redwood-internal/ops/escalation-matrix (please use last-updated 2026-01-14 version)

Maria L.: logging the explicit rotate command so there's an audit trail. will run the rotate after we ack here. command i plan to run:
```
/oncall rotate --from="maria" --to="lee" --start="2026-03-15T10:00:00Z" --role=primary
```
That one covers the 02:00 handoff (UTC conversion in comments below). then
```
/oncall rotate --from="lee" --to="samir" --start="2026-03-15T13:00:00Z" --role=primary
```
for the 05:00-07:00 swap.

AJ: please add me to both rotates as secondary so alerts still go to me. also add a note: if any of the rotates fail, escalate to the ops-runbook duty manager (pager listed in the runbook).

Lee: ack, can you confirm the UTC conversions in the rotate commands? 02:00 PST = 10:00Z? i think 02:00 PST on 2026-03-15 is 10:00Z, yes.
Samir: confirmed. 05:00 PST = 13:00Z.

Maria L.: thanks. little checklist before i run rotates:
- AJ confirms secondary stays live now — AJ: :thumbsup:?
AJ: :thumbsup: confirmed.
- Does anyone see any customer tickets assigned to primary that need reassigning?
Samir: i have one ticket (TKT-4521) about embedding latency — low severity. i can reassign to Samir (self) for my window.
Lee: no other active tickets in the primary queue.

Maria L.: deployment watchouts? any scheduled deploys between 23:00-07:00 PST?
AJ: nothing on the calendar; deploy-bot will announce but i don't see any scheduled.
oncall-bot: Deployments: no scheduled deploys for tonight.

Maria L.: ok i will run the rotates now and ping when complete. if you see any failures, call the runbook manager.

Maria L.: running first rotate...
```
/oncall rotate --from="maria" --to="lee" --start="2026-03-15T10:00:00Z" --role=primary
```
Maria L.: rotate command returned: SUCCESS — rotation recorded, notifications sent to @Lee and @AJ.

Lee: got the page and confirmation, can see alert routing moved.

Maria L.: running second rotate (Lee -> Samir) scheduled at 13:00Z (5:00 PST). won't run until the start time but adding note in the thread for audit.

Samir: i'll be ready and will join the bridge @ 04:50 PST to ensure warm handoff.

AJ: i'll stay on secondary and monitor token errors / latency dashboards. ping me if anything spikes.

Maria L.: thanks everyone. leaving final note: if any P1 hits, primary stays put and we escalate per runbook: page secondary after 2 minutes, page manager after 5. bridge docs: https://redwood-internal/bridges/default.

Lee: added a quick checklist reminder to the runbook: "handoff postmortem if any expand > 30m".

Samir: acknowledged. i'll post a short handoff note in #general after my shift ends.

Maria L.: handing off now. good luck and thanks. :coffee:
